title: Excavations in Palestine, 1932-3: Jerusalem, Baqa'a
author: (round-up; sounding by R. Neuville with M. Stekelis)
location_note: Baqa'a, Jerusalem (prehistoric surface station); placed by name.
notes: May-June 1933 sounding on the slope of an ancient water-course (a natural feature): stratified Acheulean-Levalloisian gravels under soil with sherds not earlier than MB; Chellean layers below in building foundations nearby. No eligible feature.
